messages.text: Well let's test out our messaging platform shall we? So as everyone is now aware, Stylez is no longer with us. I really liked the guy and hes obviously a very talented, experienced  DJ/MC.  I wish that management and he could have come to a mutual beneficial understanding about going forward. I also have been in many different positions over the years including being on the receiving end of the bullshit like Stylez believes he was. I purposefully stayed out of that conversation as much as possible as it was not mine to really have. I just made sure Stylez recongnized that I saw the worth in having him around and did everything that I could to help them come to a mutually beneficial agreement but I guess it was just not meant to be. I completely respect and appreciate what Stylez has done here over the years but I also respect that a man has to take care of his family and if a better offer appears on the table at any point you gotta do what you gotta do. I wish him well and hope that he finds the right situation for him at this point. I really did want to get to know him more and have another experienced vet with me to lead this rag tag group of rejects into battle!!!!! I'm kidding of course......... kinda....... No, I've already told you guys your strengths and the  things we need to improve upon in order to get where I wanna go and that is almost total domination of the mens club scene in boise in general but also grabbing a large demographic from the downtown clubs, especially on the weekends.. I really have no doubt that all three of you guys are going to be phenomenal at this in a way you never even knew you could be and take that on to bigger and better things whenever you are ready to leave this area or state or country. .ANNNDDDDD in the meantime, before you fly from the nest and engage upon your own life adventure in this or another business, I feel like YOU SHOULD BE MAKING A LOT OF MONEY!!!!

So that's what I am here to do..... PERIOD. For the club, for you, for the entertainers, and for me..... So I do have a little bit of (not) Bad news I don't think but...... so  first thing is, I am going to ask that everyone just try to make themselves a little more open and available over the next few weeks until I can get a couple of guys hired. That means maybe working a little more than you want too and maybe getting near some burnout because of said hours. If this is the case please let me know. I would ask that you think of this time of a few weeks of some extra shifts (hopefully not that long) as an opportunity for you to squirrel away some decent money right before we go into season and all the stuff the torches does during the holidays.

So now that all this capital expenditure is happening, and Joanna and Mans have literally doubled the amount I was allowed to spend — we are going to have one of the dopest A/V shows around. No bullshit.  It is going to be a blast working here and the money is going to get ridiculous. At what point that takes over, I don't know. I don't know the Boise market very well, as I'm sure you've realized. Different regions need different tactics and approaches. Some ideas catch on faster than others depending on the locality and other variables.  But the great thing is — I KNOW that the events I've been developing WILL work, and DO work. And I am perfectly fine with that.  Now that I know for a fact this is happening 100%, and the Montgomerys are investing this much time, energy, and money into their business, my ideas, and YOU… I WILL NOT fail them.  With that said, there might be times I come off a little cranky, or like someone who is just on your ass ALL THE TIME. I'll apologize in advance right here and now — just get ready to jump headfirst into this motherfucker, believe in Mans and Joanna, Bob, Megan, and my vision, and it is going to be a grand ole time!!  (HAHAHAHA… lol… sorry, that was the first phrase that came to mind for some reason. I was thinking about retyping something else and then I was like — fuck it, it's hilarious.)

oh and last thing, as far as message #2 that I sent... that's not even taking into account that Nico is taking off for a good number of days coming up here shortly. So like I said, I will try to get a someone in here to train asap because if not.... the three of us that are left are going to be absolutely beat the hell up from those hours so I will try hard to get that taken care of sooner rather than later. Thanks guys and always reach out to me with any issues that arise and don't put any personal information into this chat. If its personal, contact them personally. This is strictly for club communication. Thanks
